My energetic 5-month-old Maltipoo puppy is attending a twice-weekly training course. I hope to be able to train him in a fun way while listening to the instructor's advice!

We went to the grand opening event. We played a lot with friends from the Meguro main store in the bright indoor dog run with large windows, and even tried our hand at agility!

It's close to the station, and the nearby Futako Tamagawa Park was great too. I can't wait to see the teachers, so I'll definitely come back!

I went to the School of DOG Futako Tamagawa branch grand opening event. The facility has two running areas and is very clean, allowing dogs to relax and enjoy themselves, making it a great place to attend school.

This is the second school to open following the Meguro school! ️It's located right next to the park, so it's an excellent environment. The new school building is on the first floor, so it's easy to get in and out, and it's new and bright, so it's fun to come here! The teachers are also trustworthy, so it's reassuring! Best of all, Wan has so much fun that he doesn't want to go home when I go to pick him up.

I think the location is great, right in front of a big park. 
There are also two dog run areas, so you can bring your dog there and have fun, whether it's sunny or rainy.
There was a big park nearby and they were delighted to be able to play lots in the beautiful indoor dog run!
My dog ​​enjoyed doing agility training with the trainer and playing with other dogs in the dog run. I felt at ease knowing they were watching over him. 😊 …

I usually go to the Meguro branch, but I visited during the pre-opening. The location is great, it's a calm place, and the facilities inside the school are designed with dogs in mind. I'll come visit again!
My dogs' school opened this new location and they have been so great to our dogs and I would encourage everyone to try them out. They have excellent trainers and facilities.
The new dog school is beautiful, and I'm looking forward to taking my dog ​​there every time. The location is also great, near Futako-Tamagawa Park!
